title: Green triangles near LAX are airliner bokeh
summary: Michael Shurmer tells of Green triangles near LAX are airliner bokeh, about 2020s at Los Angeles International Airport, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Also, the triangular, all the shows show these triangular green-shaped UAPs near LAX. They're not.

plain: Michael Shermer, a well-known skeptic who debated UFOs on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that the green triangular objects shown on many UFO shows near LAX, Los Angeles International Airport, are not mysterious craft at all. In his view they are bokeh, the blurry shapes a camera makes when it films bright lights out of focus, here the lights of airliners. If he is right, a famous set of sightings would be an effect of camera lenses.
